rules.label: same-lineage
rules.requires: For conservative public leakage grouping: same pinned repository, same fixture path after removing only an explicit save-version directory, matching basename and LVSR versions matching those directories; alternatively identical XML-declared library/class/member chain plus matching class-relative path in copies of the same test harness. Cite every member location and save field, and XML declaration containers/lines for the second route.
rules.meaning: Keep together as public variants; no claim of identical behavior, native ownership, direction of derivation or proven resave history.

rules.label: independent
rules.requires: Positive, cited provenance establishing separately authored origins and excluding shared templates/derivation, supported by member paths, repository identities and XML or binary name evidence. Different hashes, save versions, paths, owners or repositories alone never suffice.
rules.meaning: Do not assign merely because basename collisions or different class methods exist; no pilot group meets this rule.

rules.label: undecidable
rules.requires: Use when R1 or R2 evidence is incomplete, conflicting, or only covers a subset of the group. Retain all member locations and available save/name clues, and state the missing provenance or structural evidence.
rules.meaning: Visible unresolved gap; do not merge the entire candidate or infer independence. Overlapping groups must receive consistent decisions.
